schedule.title: Schedule compliance
schedule.none: No frozen week ended in the period: schedule compliance is measured on the frozen baseline.
schedule.detail: {{done}} done of {{total}} planned in the frozen baseline
schedule.formula: Baseline hours of the frozen weeks that ended in the period whose work was finished by the end of its week ÷ baseline hours. A job later released or cancelled counts as not done; weeks never frozen are not measured.

mix.basisCount: Based on work-order counts (no labour hours recorded)
mix.none: No work order completed in this period.

planned.title: Planned work
planned.formula: Labour hours of completed preventive, condition-based, inspection, overhaul and improvement work orders ÷ labour hours of all completed work orders. Work-order counts are used when no labour hours are recorded.

reactive.title: Reactive work
reactive.formula: Labour hours of completed corrective and emergency work orders ÷ labour hours of all completed work orders.

emergency.title: Emergency work
emergency.formula: Labour hours of completed emergency work orders ÷ labour hours of all completed work orders.

pm.title: PM compliance
pm.none: No preventive maintenance was due in this period.
pm.formula: PM occurrences done within their tolerance window — not before it opens, not after it closes (without tolerance: on the due day) ÷ PM occurrences due in the period that are done or whose window has closed. Cancelled occurrences are excluded; those still inside their window are not counted yet. Same figure as the PM page and the home tile.

backlog.title: Backlog
backlog.noCapacity: {{hours}} of work, but no crew capacity is known: give active personnel a work schedule.
backlog.detail: {{hours}} planned on {{count}} open work orders · ready to schedule: {{ready}}
backlog.capacity: Capacity used: {{hours}} per week ({{people}} people, from their work schedules)
backlog.withoutSchedule_one: {{count}} active person without a work schedule is not counted
backlog.withoutSchedule_other: {{count}} active people without a work schedule are not counted
backlog.withoutEstimate_one: {{count}} open work order has no time estimate (counted as 0 h)
backlog.withoutEstimate_other: {{count}} open work orders have no time estimate (counted as 0 h)
backlog.formula: Planned hours of work orders not yet done ÷ weekly crew hours. Crew hours = working-day shifts of the work schedule of each active person.
backlog.period: Now, compared with the start of the selected period

rav.title: Maintenance cost / replacement value
rav.needsValue: Needs a replacement value on assets ({{valued}} of {{total}} assets have one).
rav.detail: {{cost}} a year (annualised) on {{rav}} of replacement value · {{valued}} of {{total}} assets valued
rav.formula: Cost of work orders closed in the period on assets that have a replacement value, annualised, ÷ total replacement value of those assets.

smrp.wrenchTime: Not measured: wrench time (share of hands-on work in paid time) needs work sampling, which is not recorded in Maintafox.
